_comment: The Join the Boosters page. Everything here is placeholder text. Leave a "url" empty and its button turns into a grey placeholder instead of a link.
heading: Join Drama Boosters!
lead: Please join and/or donate to the Legacy Drama Boosters in support of the Legacy Drama Club. No meeting requirements for general membership!
mission: The Boosters support the Legacy Drama Club with the funds, organization and volunteers that turn student ambition into great stage performances.

committees.heading: Committees
committees.intro: Joining a committee is optional, but very much appreciated.

items.name: Costumes & Makeup
items.what: Plans costumes and makeup - tails, tentacles, sailor suits and all.

items.name: Front of House
items.what: Tickets, concessions, ushering and programs on show nights.

items.name: Marketing
items.what: Posters, social media and getting the word out.

items.name: Production
items.what: Sets and props - from King Triton's throne to Eric's ship.

items.name: Rehearsal Help
items.what: Helps the director at rehearsals as available.

items.name: Stage Crew
items.what: Moves sets and props backstage during performances.

items.name: Tech
items.what: Lights, sound and the rest of the technical side.
